_comment: Tier table of the plan contract (local coding contract, spec section 5). A plan header names
a TIER, this file maps it to a resolver ROLE and a file limit, and model_resolver.py names the
tag at run time. No model tag is written here, ever (R2); a test asserts it. Every value is
{value, provenance} (R4). The numbers are proposals of 2026-10-17, tuned at the owner's review.

role.provenance: proposal 2026-10-17, tuned at the owner's review: a short plan whose step output fits the coder window

max_files.provenance: proposal 2026-10-17, tuned at the owner's review

role.provenance: proposal 2026-10-17, tuned at the owner's review: the ten-file plan limit of R26

max_files.provenance: specified: R26 caps a plan at ten files

role.provenance: proposal 2026-10-17, tuned at the owner's review: the 262K path, a plan whose step output cannot fit the coder window and cannot be split

Single source of the size ceilings, spec decision D9
